data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding, net of reinsurance recoveries is a favourable development of GBP 15.0m (2018: favourable development of GBP 3.5m); this is mainly comprised of releases of GBP 13.6m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business and releases of GBP 1.6m in respect of total Reinsurance business.

prior_year_events.event_name: Resolution of dispute with a third party administrator (return of claims and legal costs)
prior_year_events.impact_description: Return of certain claims paid under historic binding authority agreements and legal costs totalling GBP 11.75m, which benefited the 2018 result

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims development table shows a net adverse prior-year gross reserve movement of approximately GBP 30.5m (c.5.94% of opening gross reserves), driven by adverse development in a number of underwriting years (notably 2017, 2016, 2015 and 2014) partially offset by releases in older years. However, the Managing Agent reports a net favourable prior year development of GBP 15.0m after reinsurance recoveries and a favourable settlement of a historic dispute which returned claims and legal costs. The gross/net divergence indicates significant reinsurance recoveries and one-off legal/administrative benefits materially affecting the net position.
raw_causal_phrases: favourable development of GBP 15.0m (2018: favourable development of GBP 3.5m)
this is mainly comprised of releases of GBP 13.6m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business and releases of GBP 1.6m in respect of total Reinsurance business
prior year releases across a number of Casualty classes
the return of certain claims paid under these binding authority agreements and legal costs totalling GBP 11.75m
data.data_quality_notes: The Managing Agent's note reports a NET favourable prior year development of GBP 15.0m (explicit). A gross prior-year movement was not stated explicitly in that paragraph. I computed a gross prior-year movement (+GBP 30.531m strengthening) from the gross claims development table (page 36) by comparing the latest estimate for underwriting years <=2017 with the previous diagonal estimates (per the instructions). The note's LOB breakdown (releases of GBP 13.6m and GBP 1.6m) is presented in the context of the NET movement; it is unclear whether those per-LOB figures are gross or net. I therefore assigned them to lob_movements with medium confidence. All monetary figures are reported in the native financial statement currency (GBP).
